title: "Lecture Slides"

The sequence follows Agresti's seven chapters after a short introduction. The introductory deck is a draft; the chapter decks are scope outlines, with derivations, examples, exercises, and validated notebooks still to develop.

| Deck | Title | Main reading | Status |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| 00 | [Why Bayesian?](../slides/00-why-bayesian.html) | Orientation; Efron–Hastie 2–4 | Short introductory draft |
| 01 | [Foundations](../slides/01-bayesian-foundations.html) | Chapter 1 | Scope outline |
| 02 | [Proportions](../slides/02-proportions.html) | Chapter 2 | Scope outline |
| 03 | [Means and Normal Models](../slides/03-means-and-normal-models.html) | Chapter 3 | Scope outline |
| 04 | [Linear Models](../slides/04-linear-models.html) | Chapter 4 | Scope outline |
| 05 | [GLMs and Hierarchies](../slides/05-glms-and-hierarchical-models.html) | Chapter 5 | Scope outline |
| 06 | [Posterior Computation](../slides/06-posterior-computation.html) | Chapter 6 | Scope outline |
| 07 | [Model Choice](../slides/07-model-choice-and-extensions.html) | Chapter 7 | Scope outline |

See the [proposed 15-week roadmap](../index.qmd#course-roadmap) for hour budgets and the blend of Agresti with the earlier Bayesian syllabus. See [Resources](resources.qmd) for the required text and supporting references.
